title: Just Who on Earth Are You?

text_block_list.text:
—Once,
there was an umamusume hailed as a living
myth.

15 wins across 19 starts;
the second Classic Triple Crown winner in
history.
Though she left an enduring fervor upon the
turf—

No one had emerged since who was said to
surpass her...
Leaving the racing world craving the arrival
of the next great myth.

As if to shatter that lingering
stagnation—
one umamusume was running through the rain
with singular focus.
Haa, haa, haa, haa...!

She tore across the turf at an extraordinary
pace.
Her speed never faltered; if anything,
she kept accelerating—
Haaaaah...!

Rounding the turn,
200 meters before the wire.
Digging in deep,
lowering her center—
she shot forward like a coiled spring.

Her breathtaking speed accelerated
again, and again,
and again—leaving common sense far behind.

Shaking the earth, shedding the rain,
sprinting like the wind itself.
She was so vivid, so electrifying,
I forgot to even breathe—

...Haa, haa... Whew!
Ah—! Running without an opponent really just
doesn't cut it.

Then again,
who'd come out to the track on a day like—
hm?

...The overwhelming shock sent my heart
pounding and my legs trembling,
leaving me rooted to the spot.

If I could run the Twinkle Series alongside
her, we would witness
sights impossible to see anywhere else.
That conviction surged within me.
choice_data_list: (I need to scout her right now!)

text_block_list.text: Heeey! You, over there!

Got a minute?
Wanna run a lap with—
Oh? Wait, you're a Trainer?

My bad, my bad,
couldn't see clearly through the rain.
Mistook you for someone else.
Catch ya later!
Hm?

I might have rushed it...
but timing is everything.
I poured out every word I had to convey the
sheer awe I had just felt.

How her speed had captivated me so deeply
I couldn't look away,
and how certain I was that together,
we'd reach unprecedented heights.

Having said all that,
I realized I hadn't made any concrete
proposals.
Frantically searching for an example,
my mind raced—
choice_data_list: Even the Classic Triple Crown woul...

text_block_list.text: ...I see. Thanks. But sorry, no can do.
Shot down instantly.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: That girl was Mr. C.B., right?!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Her mother was a famed racer,
and her father was that racer's Trainer!
Being their daughter,
rumors have been flying since before she
enrolled.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her in person, she's got crazy talent,
not to mention that totally
unconventional running style.
Everyone's thinking she could be the next
Triple Crown winner—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
No, maybe even someone who surpasses the
living myth!
Trainers have been lining up nonstop hoping
to scout her.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Though so far,
she's rejected every single one with a 100%
record. Status and track records
mean nothing to her.
Nobody even knows what kind of Trainer she's
looking for.

She was far more popular than I'd imagined.
As I slumped my shoulders,
thinking I was out of my league...
my colleague lowered their voice
meaningfully.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
This is just a guess...
but if she's turning down everyone,
that means she didn't reject you specifically,
right?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely too early to give up.
If you've only been turned down once,
isn't now your chance to show how dedicated
you are...?
And so—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh? A present? Oho, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Hmm,
is this... a training menu?
I get it,
you put together a custom routine tailored
just for me!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And these, horseshoes? Whoa, custom-made!
Huh, they're designed to reduce strain on
the toes. That's thoughtful.

After consulting her instructor and poring
over mock race records,
I presented the gifts I'd prepared.
However—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, but... sorry, I can't take these.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If I take them, it'll get your hopes up,
right?
I'm really not great with that stuff.
Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll just take the thought.
Thanks anyway!

Turned down flat,
I was shot down for the second time.
